# Anivex Solution

> Anivex Solution is an Indian software engineering and technology company founded by Krishndas Chauhan, building custom websites, web applications, GST-compliant ERP systems, mobile apps, and business automation software for enterprises in Uttar Pradesh and across India.

## Official Brand Identity

- **Company Name:** Anivex Solution
- **Website:** https://anivexsolution.in/
- **Founder & Lead Architect:** Krishndas Chauhan (MCA, Mangalayatan University; BCA, APCS College of IT & Management)
- **Headquarters:** Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India (226010)
- **Primary Service Regions:** Jaunpur, Machhlishahar, Lucknow, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India, and worldwide remote delivery
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 79056 68826
- **Email:** anivexsolution@gmail.com
- **Business Hours:** Monday – Saturday, 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM IST
- **Commercial Terms:** Official GST tax invoicing (18% GST), milestone-based billing in INR (₹), 100% source code & intellectual property handover, and 30–60 day post-launch warranty support.

## Engineering Services

- [Web Development](https://anivexsolution.in/web-development): Custom corporate websites, full-stack web platforms, e-commerce with UPI/Razorpay, and Core Web Vitals optimization.
- [UI/UX Web Design](https://anivexsolution.in/web-design): Design systems, interactive prototypes, responsive cross-device layouts, and accessibility audits.
- [Custom Software Development](https://anivexsolution.in/software-development): Bespoke business software, REST/GraphQL API engineering, database architecture, and legacy modernization.
- [Web Application Development](https://anivexsolution.in/web-application-development): Multi-tenant SaaS platforms, client portals, real-time dashboards, and workflow automation apps.
- [ERP Development](https://anivexsolution.in/erp-development): GST billing & invoicing, multi-branch inventory management, financial ledgers, and automated WhatsApp invoice dispatch.
- [Custom Software Solutions](https://anivexsolution.in/custom-software): Tailored process automation engines, internal dashboards, and industry-specific digital tools.

## Proprietary Software Products

- **PolicyHub:** Enterprise document and policy governance suite with granular access control, versioning, audit trails, and semantic search.
- **VyaparDesk ERP:** Indian GST billing, barcode stock tracking, multi-warehouse inventory synchronization, and automated WhatsApp invoice delivery.
- **Anivex OpsGrid:** Unified enterprise operations and telemetry monitor with modular metrics and role-based permissions.
